title: Call sprint playbook + live notes
content:
Purpose: 2-hour morning outbound sprint focused on high-intent SMB accounts + quick follow-ups. Goal: 6 connects, 2 demos booked, update CRM + note 1 obvious product ask per account.

Sprint rules (quick):
- Timebox 50m work / 10m admin (repeat twice).
- Cold call -> voicemail -> quick personalized email (within 15m) -> LinkedIn if no response in 48h.
- Use demo checkbox in CRM to mark as 'demo-ready' only if contact verbalizes interest in product trial or performance numbers.
- If stuck >2 mins on a research point, skip and flag for pre-call research slot.

Morning checklist (8:30–11:30):
- 08:25 quick prep: open 3 tabs: CRM list, snippets doc, zoom demo link
- 08:30 sprint 1 start (50m)
- 09:20 admin update (10m): log calls, send voicemails/emails
- 09:30 sprint 2 start (50m)
- 10:20 admin (10m)
- 10:30 quick review: escalate any demo leads to manager

Top 12 prioritized call list (notes + one-liners to open with):
1) Hartsfield Logistics (Ben R) – spoke at conference Q1, use the latency-cost angle; mention Dedicated pools. CRM: lead-2381. Best time: 9–11am.
2) ParcelFlow (Maya T) – CTO shifted from managed APIs; concern: model drift. Open: "How are you measuring generation quality today?"
3) Tutorly (Sanjiv P) – high embedding usage, trial quota issue last month. Offer Optimize suggestions (caching + quant).
4) OmniRetail (Laura J) – enterprise; note: procurement cycle long, ask about security/compliance checklist.
5) GreenShift (Ethan) – early-stage, tight budget. Pitch free credits + burst capacity.
6) AtlasLegal (Renee C) – need private deployment; ask about SOC2/KMS.
7) ClearVoice (Darren) – content generation pipeline; bring up rollout A/B testing feature.
8) FinEdge (Olga V) – regulatory; ask about on-prem evaluation window.
9) MedQuery (Dr. Park) – very sensitive PII; highlight audit logs + HSM.
10) ByteLabs (Iker) – dev-forward, show fast integration snippets.
11) EduSpark (Priya G) – educator license discuss; potential pilot.
12) NeoAssistant (Marco) – competitor user migrating; value prop: unit economics + availability.

Quick email templates (paste variants into snippets):
- Voicemail follow-up (short): "Ben — left a quick voicemail about Redwood inference dedicated pools. Short call to map latency needs this week? Calendly: calendly.com/rita-chen/demo"
- Cold intro (personalized): "Hi {{first}}, noticed your team is doing high-volume embeddings — we recently helped a merchant reduce per-embedding cost by 42% with caching + quantization; quick 20-min call?"
- Reconnect after event: "Great meeting you at StartupConf — follow-up with a short demo tailored to the use case we discussed."

Quick CRM actions to take after each call:
- Update lead status: attempt_1 / connected / no_answer / voicemail_sent
- Add 1-sentence discovery note and next step with date
- Add 'product ask' tag if they request feature/limit
- For demo-ready: create demo task, cc solutions-eng alias

Metrics to track (I'll log real numbers after sprint):
- Calls dialed: 
- Live connects: 
- VMs left: 
- Emails sent post-call: 
- Demos booked: 

Escalations / blockers (to mention in standup):
- Demo environment permission delays (needs SRE exec signoff)
- Pricing questions for Dedicated (need pricing sheet revision 3)
- One account (AtlasLegal) requests full vendor security packet — ping security team (ticket created)

Notes-to-self (research items flagged during calls):
- Check docs for quantized 8-bit perf numbers (link to confluence playbook)
- Verify latency SLOs for 2k token context on p4d (who owns this repo?)
- Update snippets: replace old "burst capacity" paragraph with new pricing verbiage

Follow-ups to send end-of-day (templates below):
- For warm connects: "Thanks for your time today — attaching short demo recording + next steps. If useful, I can spin up a short PD trial for X workspace."
- For no-shows: quick calendar reschedule link + 2 optional times

Final quick personal log (fill after sprint):
- Mood: 
- Biggest win: 
- Biggest blocker: 
- 1 thing to improve tomorrow:

Scratch area (live notes during calls):
- Ben (Hartsfield): cares about 95th pct latency on inference spikes — ask about peak qps and tolerance.
- Maya (ParcelFlow): uses several 3rd-party models; worried about cost variance. Mention Optimize reports.
- Sanjiv: embeddings cost and index re-rank; asked about offline batch embedding jobs.

End of doc — quick copy to CRM and ping Tom/SE for 2 demos.
